marks.q: We remain on track to meet our 2021 full year guidance of 53.5 to 59.5 moz of silver (including Silverstream) and 675 to 725 koz of gold.

Attributable silver production expected to be in the range of 50.5 to 56.5 moz (including Silverstream) in line with 2021 and below our previous estimate due to a lower volume of ore processed at Saucito driven by a shortage of personnel

There is an inevitable degree of caution around expectations for 2022 and beyond, with operational challenges being potentially worsened by the pandemic - and the knock-on effect on workforce availability - as well as by the ongoing impact following the implementation of the new labour law.
We are reporting a solid first quarter's production, in line with expectations.
We have started 2022 in line with our expectations and our guidance is unchanged.
We remain on track to meet our 2022 full year guidance of 50.5 to 56.5 moz of attributable silver (including Silverstream) and 600 to 650 koz of attributable gold production.
We remain on track to meet our 2022 full year guidance of 50.5 to 56.5 moz of attributable silver (including Silverstream) and 600 to 650 koz of attributable gold production.
Nonetheless, we are confident in the overall performance of the business and our full year production guidance remains unchanged.
As a result, there is no impact on 2022 production, nor on our 2023 production expectations.
Our 2023 guidance issued today is in line with previous expectations in terms of silver equivalent ounces.
Fresnillo delivered a resilient operating performance in 2022, with our people rising to meet a number of external challenges and deliver on our production guidance.
We have successfully managed through considerable recent challenges, reaching a sound level of operational consistency, putting us well on track to meet our full year production guidance.
As such, there is no change to our 2023 full year production guidance.
We have started 2023 well and we are confident in delivering on our guidance for the year.
I am pleased to report a solid production performance in the first half and confirm that our full year guidance is unchanged.
Attributable silver production is expected to be in the range of 57.0 to 64.0 moz (including Silverstream) while attributable gold production is expected to be in the range of 590 to 640 koz.
We remain on track to meet our full year production guidance.
Silver production was up 4.7% year on year driven by the ramp up at Juanicipio and higher ore grade at San Julián Veins, albeit it was slightly below expectations.
Silver production was up 4.7% year on year driven by the ramp up at Juanicipio and higher ore grade at San Julián Veins, albeit it was slightly below expectations.
We achieved our guidance of 105.1 million silver equivalent ounces with gold, lead and zinc production within our guided range.
We have started the year with our performance in line with our expectations.
2024 has started as expected and our full year guidance is unchanged.
The Group has maintained the steady operating performance demonstrated in the first quarter and we remain on track to meet full year guidance.

We are on track to meet full year production guidance and we are committed to managing our operations efficiently without compromising on the safety of our people or on continued investment into our longer term growth pipeline.
Our full year guidance set out in January remains unchanged.

In line with our strategy to focus on profit margins at the mines, the decrease in the 2025 gold guidance reflects an adjustment to the mine plan at Herradura, whereby the most profitable gold ounces will be extracted and volumes of waste material moved decreased.

The operational efficiencies initiated by our teams led to a good production performance in 2024 and I expect this to also be the case in 2025, with steady profitability underpinned by continued high prices for silver and gold.
We have started 2025 in line with our expectations, delivering a stable operating performance and maintaining the momentum we achieved in 2024.

Gold production is trending towards the upper end of our full-year guidance, driven by a strong performance at Herradura, while silver production remains in line with guidance albeit impacted by the weaker Silverstream contribution and lower grades at the Fresnillo mine.

Looking ahead, we have increased gold production guidance for the year to reflect the continued strong performance at Herradura, and we have adjusted silver production guidance to reflect the end of Silverstream contributions following the buyback agreement with Peñoles.
Production performance is in line with our expectations, and we are on track to meet our full year guidance, with gold trending towards the upper end of the range.

Gold: lower production at Herradura primarily as a result of the stronger than anticipated production during 2025 due to optimisation of the mine sequencing, with some production having been brought forward from 2026 to 2025.
We have indicated that production of silver and gold from our current operations is expected to reduce in 2026, largely due to geological factors at our operating assets.
We have started 2026 in line with our expectations, with production across our operations consistent with the guidance set at the beginning of the year.
Our focus remains firmly on operational discipline, and we remain on track to meet our full-year production guidance.
Our full-year production guidance remains unchanged, and our high-margin portfolio puts us in a strong position to capitalise on ongoing market tailwinds.
Production of gold and silver was in line with expectations in the third quarter and we remain on track to meet our full- year guidance.
